Separated & Active Vesteds::CV2.formula: IF(OR(CJ2="0",CJ2="9"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",CN2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(CJ2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(CJ2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(CR2/12,4),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity"))

Separated & Active Vesteds::DU2.formula: IF(AND(CJ2=CC2, CO2=CR2),IF(E2="1", 1, DJ2),IF(AND(L2>0,L2>DOPT,G2="R"),DJ2, IF(AND(F2="DOR",OR(DL2="OSF", DL2="OMF")), DT2,DI2)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::DV2.formula: IF(AND(F2="DOR", BY2<DOTR), AR2, IF(E2="2",ROUND(BG2*DF2*DH2*DJ2*QPSAPercent,2), ROUND(BG2*DF2*DH2*IF(AND(L2>DOPT, L2<BY2), DJ2, DU2),2)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::EV2.formula: IF(AND(F2="DOR", BY2<DOTR), AR2, IF(E2="2",ROUND((BS-BI2)*DF2*DH2*DJ2*QPSAPercent,2), ROUND((BG2-BI2)*DF2*DH2*IF(AND(L2>DOPT, L2<BY2), DJ2, DU2),2)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::GT2.formula: IF(GS2="I", "we corrected the late retirement factor.", IF(GS2="D", "we corrected the late retirement factor.", "NULL"))
